reader_summary.headline: "Mobile-first" (and now too AI-first) has been a mantra of sorts in design.
reader_summary.overview: "Mobile-first" (and now too AI-first) has been a mantra of sorts in design, but what does that mean at a company, product management, and competitive level? Especially when someone in company X will always say "we should do what Y did" -- even if they have no idea let alone data why Y did it..

key_points.text: Especially when someone in company X will always say "we should do what Y did" -- even if they have no idea let alone data why Y did it..
And while designing for screens is "like growing a carp in a bathtub" (will inevitably grow to the size of the container).
What does it mean to design for a mobile world where "an app isn't really an app" -- and the very definition of apps are themselves evolving.
